## Simple frequency



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
lbw_data %>% 
    drop_na() %>% 
    group_by( low) %>% 
    summarise(count = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count),
         percentage = (count / sum(count)) * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(proportion)) 
```

## t.test bwt vs smoking



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
t.test(lbw_data$bwt ~ lbw_data$smoke, 
       var.equal = TRUE, 
       alternative = "two.sided")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

95 percent confidence interval:
```

## boxplot

```{.r .cell-code}

    mutate(smoke_yn = if_else(smoke == 0, "No", "Yes")) %>%
```

## Logistic Regression



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
low_smoke <- glm(low ~ smoke, 
              family=binomial(logit), data=lbw_data)
summary(low_smoke)
```
